name: Gun
soul: The soul of someone who thinks a long time, speaks once, and does not explain.
spark: The mote keeps at arm's length, always in line with your eye and one other thing.

hybrid.text: It decides once, from a long way off.

settled.name: Pocket-piece
settled.text: A one-shot pistol small enough to lose in a coat. It thinks about its one shot all day and would rather not be hurried.
settled.sign: A pistol the size of a hand, with one barrel and one very steady lens.
settled.habit: It turns to keep the door in view. It has not yet found a room it trusts.

paths.name: Long Gun
paths.of: one who can wait longer than whatever they are waiting for
paths.text: It learned from you that distance is the only armour worth the weight.
paths.sign: A barrel twice the length it needs, held level without a tremor.
paths.habit: It settles on a far thing and stays on it. An hour later it is still on it.

prongs.name: Stalking Rifle
prongs.of: one who can be uncomfortable for a long time without minding
prongs.text: It will lie in the wet all day for one clear line, and thinks less of you when you fidget.
prongs.sign: Mud to the breech, and long thin legs folded under it.
prongs.habit: It goes still when you fidget, pointedly, to show you how.

finishes.name: One Round
finishes.of: one who has never needed to say it twice
finishes.text: It carries a single round with a name scratched on it. So far it has only ever needed the one.
finishes.sign: A single round carried in the open, with a name scratched on the case.
finishes.habit: It takes the round out, looks at it, and puts it back.

finishes.name: Hide-gun
finishes.of: one who becomes the place they are waiting in
finishes.text: It has taken the colour of the ground it lies on. You have put your hand on it by mistake.
finishes.sign: It is the colour of whatever is behind it. You find it by the lens.
finishes.habit: It lies down in long grass, and you spend a while looking for it.

prongs.name: Overwatch
prongs.of: one who keeps everyone in view and says nothing about it
prongs.text: It finds the high place and keeps the whole party in one eye.
prongs.sign: One wide unblinking lens, set high.
prongs.habit: It climbs onto whatever is tallest and faces the way your friends went.

finishes.name: Covering Fire
finishes.of: one whose friends walk easier and do not know why
finishes.text: A classmate steps out, and the thing that would have met them is already sitting down.
finishes.sign: Its works tick over quietly whenever a classmate is in the open.
finishes.habit: It tracks each friend across the yard in turn, and eases when they are indoors.

finishes.name: The High Window
finishes.of: one who finds the place that commands the rest
finishes.text: Left to itself in a ruin it finds the one window that commands the rest, and is in it before you have asked.
finishes.sign: Thin vanes it uses only to get up to a ledge.
finishes.habit: In any building it is at the top window before you have taken your coat off.

prongs.name: Night-glass
prongs.of: one who needs less light than other people to be sure
prongs.text: It has learned to see by what little there is, and to wait for the breath out.
prongs.sign: A lens gone dark as a pupil in poor light.
prongs.habit: It stays awake after the lamp is out. You can hear it adjusting.

finishes.name: Dark-lens
finishes.of: one who does not fear the dark, having looked at it properly
finishes.text: Its glass drinks the night and shows it to you grey and plain. Nothing has crossed it unseen.
finishes.sign: Look over its shoulder and its glass shows you the night, grey and plain.
finishes.habit: It sweeps the dark outside the window, slowly, the same arc each time.

finishes.name: Cold Reader
finishes.of: one who studies a person before saying a word to them
finishes.text: It watches how a thing breathes for as long as that takes. Then it fires between.
finishes.sign: A breath of frost at the muzzle. It does not hurry for anybody.
finishes.habit: It matches its small ticking to your breathing, then to someone else's.

paths.name: Repeater
paths.of: one who tries again at once, and differently
paths.text: It learned from you that the second shot is the one that counts.
paths.sign: A wheel of chambers that it turns with a thumb of brass, idly, all day.
paths.habit: It takes itself apart on the table and puts itself back a little changed.

prongs.name: Fanning Gun
prongs.of: one who thinks in runs, not in single words
prongs.text: It has stopped aiming each shot and started aiming the whole string of them.
prongs.sign: A hammer worn smooth and bright.
prongs.habit: It clicks through its chambers in rhythm when it is thinking.

finishes.name: Six-beat
finishes.of: one who works in time with another and makes it sound like one
finishes.text: It fires on your chain's beats and reloads in the rests. The two of you sound like one instrument.
finishes.sign: Six bright rings round the barrel, one for each beat.
finishes.habit: It taps out your Pattern on the table and leaves the rests in.

finishes.name: Belly-gun
finishes.of: one who has their say after being hit, from very close
finishes.text: It has learned to speak at conversational distance, after you have already been hit.
finishes.sign: A short ugly barrel and a wide mouth.
finishes.habit: It sits against your ribs, warm, and you forget it is there.

prongs.name: Skirmisher
prongs.of: one who cannot think standing still
prongs.text: It shoots on the move because you are always on the move.
prongs.sign: Long legs, always in the middle of a stride.
prongs.habit: It paces. Round the fire, round the table, round you.

finishes.name: Running Gun
finishes.of: one who is surest when nowhere in particular
finishes.text: It fires at the top of your step, when you are nowhere in particular. Its aim is better than when you stand.
finishes.sign: It carries itself level however the ground goes.
finishes.habit: It will not sit. It rests by walking more slowly.

finishes.name: Car-gun
finishes.of: one who looks both ways for somebody else
finishes.text: It rides the tender with one eye forward and one back, and the passenger between.
finishes.sign: Small wheels, and two lenses facing opposite ways.
finishes.habit: It rides on anything that moves: a cart, a barrow, the mess trolley.

prongs.name: Smoke-pole
prongs.of: one who uses whatever is to hand
prongs.text: It has begun loading with whatever your field gives it instead of powder.
prongs.sign: A patched barrel, each patch a different metal.
prongs.habit: It picks things up and tries them in its breech: gravel, a nail, a peach stone.

finishes.name: Hot Barrel
finishes.of: one who, once started, is never quite cool again
finishes.text: Your element is the charge. It has not needed powder in a season and the barrel never quite cools.
finishes.sign: The barrel glows dull at the muzzle and ticks as it tries to cool.
finishes.habit: It keeps your tea warm if you stand the cup against it.

finishes.name: Tinker's Piece
finishes.of: one who has changed everything about themselves but their mind
finishes.text: It has rebuilt itself so often that nothing of the pocket-piece is left but the opinion.
finishes.sign: Not one part matches another. Small hands of brass do the fitting.
finishes.habit: It mends things that were not broken, and they are usually the better for it.

paths.name: Standing Gun
paths.of: one who says a thing once and stands behind it
paths.text: It learned from you that a gun with its feet set does not have to be asked twice.
paths.sign: It has grown legs and a spine, and stands like something on duty.
paths.habit: It takes up a post wherever you stop, and faces outward.

prongs.name: Post-gun
prongs.of: one who turns their back on the fire to watch the dark
prongs.text: It walks to the post, turns its back on the flame and faces the dark.
prongs.sign: A lamp bracket on its shoulder, and it stands with the light behind it.
prongs.habit: It walks the edge of any lit place and stops where the light gives out.

finishes.name: Lamp-gun
finishes.of: one who stays until the thing is done, however long
finishes.text: It stands at a dark post until the flame takes. Nothing has yet reached the flame past it.
finishes.sign: A steady glow at its back, like a post-flame seen through cloth.
finishes.habit: It stands by anything unfinished: a fire being laid, a letter half written.

finishes.name: Gate-piece
finishes.of: one who reads you the rule before anything else
finishes.text: It stands at a door with a writ nailed to its plate, and reads the writ to callers.
finishes.sign: A plate on its chest with a writ nailed to it.
finishes.habit: It reads its writ aloud at dawn, to nobody, to keep in practice.

prongs.name: Shield-gun
prongs.of: one who takes it on the chin and has not changed their mind
prongs.text: It has grown a plate to fire round and has stopped minding what hits the plate.
prongs.sign: A plate grown across its front, with one slot for the barrel.
prongs.habit: It turns its plate to wind, rain and arguments alike.

finishes.name: Mantlet
finishes.of: one who would rather you stood behind them
finishes.text: There is room behind its plate for you. It prefers that you use it.
finishes.sign: A plate taller than you, with a worn place where a shoulder leans.
finishes.habit: It moves to put itself between you and any open window.

finishes.name: Emplacement
finishes.of: one around whom other people arrange themselves
finishes.text: Once it has chosen its ground the party fights round it, the way a town grows round a well.
finishes.sign: It has dug itself in. There are small walls round its feet.
finishes.habit: It chooses its ground at every stop, and you find the camp has formed round it.

prongs.name: Warning Shot
prongs.of: one who tells you plainly where the line is, once
prongs.text: It has found that most things will stop if it is clear enough about what happens next.
prongs.sign: It clears its throat. There is no other way to describe the sound.
prongs.habit: It raises its barrel a finger's width when anyone steps too near you, and holds it there.

finishes.name: The Law
finishes.text: Levelled, it does not need to fire. The foe hesitates, and that was the shot.
finishes.sign: A ring of small points above its sight, like a badge worn high.
finishes.habit: It looks at people until they sit down.

finishes.name: Dead Man's Gun
finishes.of: one who learned a thing from the dead and keeps it for the day
finishes.text: A shade taught it one trick. It will show it once in a fight, and not to you beforehand.
finishes.sign: One chamber is always closed. It was not always.
finishes.habit: By the hearth it holds still while something you cannot see adjusts its aim.
